{{Quote|The Senate will hear about this!|Naboo delegate|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
An '''encounter''' took place on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] were escorting [[Diplomat/Legends|delegates]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] attacked them at the order of [[Sith Master/Legends|his master]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Lord Sidious]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] was able to drive off Darth Maul. The incident was later investigated, to no avail.

==Encounter==
{{Quote|This is Panaka. We are under attack. We need assistance. [...]''"<br />"''Requesting permission to engage the enemy.''"<br />"''Engage the enemy, Sykes!|Captain Panaka to Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] arranged an encounter by ordering his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to test the ability of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 62" /> Darth Maul in his [[Scimitar/Legends|Infiltrator]] came out of nowhere and attacked two Naboo [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] and the [[Diplomat/Legends|delegates]] on their landing platform on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] ordered [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] to drive away the attacker. Sykes succeeded in launching [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] from his N-1 starfighter at Darth Maul and drove him away, even though Maul was launching [[airborne mine]]s at him.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
During the chase, Sykes found a vehicular upgrade.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|That got him!|Lieutenant Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
A later investigation by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] into the incident turned up nothing.<ref name="Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 62" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Coruscant Encounter'' is a bonus mission in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'', unlocked after acquiring all silver medals in the main campaign or through the use of cheat codes. A vehicular upgrade appears in the mission and picking it up fulfills the bonus objective. The mission does not specify when the encounter happens, but it had to be before [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], as Darth Maul was defeated on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and believed to be dead during the course of the film. Picking up the hidden upgrade will fulfill the bonus objective. The [[2011]] magazine [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 62|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 62]] confirmed that the event happened before the movie.
